meaning: One AD companion requirement for each immutable domain-first TBQ. The companions identify when differentiation changes the scientific workflow, the no-AD control, and the evidence needed. They do not redefine the source question or claim whole-TBQ completion.

status_vocabulary.ad_native_verified: A Rust-native witness validates this companion formulation; the source TBQ may still contain additional requirements.
status_vocabulary.implementable_unverified: Required reusable primitives exist, but the exact workflow lacks a frozen oracle, result record, or CI witness.
status_vocabulary.missing_ad_rule: The forward workflow is available, but at least one reusable parameterization, JVP, VJP, or composition rule is incomplete.
status_vocabulary.missing_forward_physics: The source scientific workflow itself is not fully implemented; native AD cannot yet be validated end to end.
status_vocabulary.conditionally_differentiable: A derivative is valid only within a fixed branch, graph, solver, or representation; the discrete event requires forward validation.
status_vocabulary.ad_not_central: AD may assist a continuous inner loop, but is not the scientific acceptance target for this question.

role_vocabulary.essential: AD changes tractability or directly yields the target sensitivity.
role_vocabulary.helpful: AD improves attribution or efficiency but is not required for the forward claim.
role_vocabulary.conditional: AD is meaningful only after a discrete branch or representation is fixed.
role_vocabulary.not_central: The scientific target is fundamentally a discrete or forward classification.

physical-parameter-spaces.label: Physical parameter spaces
physical-parameter-spaces.description: Typed continuous controls with bounds, units, reparameterizations, and explicit separation from discrete model choices.

complex-generalized-basis.label: Complex and generalized-basis differentiation
complex-generalized-basis.description: Rules for complex Hamiltonians, overlap matrices, constrained Hermiticity, and basis-covariant pullbacks.

geometry-strain-defects.label: Geometry, strain, and defect parameterization
geometry-strain-defects.description: Differentiable coordinates, strain fields, hopping laws, and fixed-topology defect or interface parameterizations.

gauge-fields-drives.label: Gauge fields and drive parameterization
gauge-fields-drives.description: Gauge-covariant rules for Peierls phases, magnetic fields, time origin, amplitudes, frequencies, and waveform controls.

disorder-ensembles.label: Disorder and ensemble differentiation
disorder-ensembles.description: Seeded reparameterization, common-random-number gradients, and distributional objectives with uncertainty estimates.

lead-bias-thermodynamics.label: Lead, bias, and thermodynamic controls
lead-bias-thermodynamics.description: Physical controls for leads, contacts, chemical potentials, temperature, energy, and finite-bias boundary conditions.

hermitian-subspaces.label: Hermitian spectral-subspace rules
hermitian-subspaces.description: Gauge-safe eigensystem and projector derivatives, including degenerate occupied subspaces and generalized eigenproblems.

nonhermitian-subspaces.label: Non-Hermitian spectral rules
nonhermitian-subspaces.description: Biorthogonal, Schur-subspace, exceptional-point, and pseudospectral differentiation with conditioning diagnostics.

linear-resolvent-adjoints.label: Dense and sparse linear-resolvent adjoints
linear-resolvent-adjoints.description: Reusable JVP and VJP rules for dense or iterative linear solves, resolvents, self-energies, and preconditioned sparse operators.

implicit-stationarity.label: Implicit fixed-point and stationarity rules
implicit-stationarity.description: Adjoints for converged fixed points, self-consistency, stationarity conditions, and reusable factorization state.

time-floquet-adjoints.label: Time evolution and Floquet adjoints
time-floquet-adjoints.description: Checkpointed propagation and rules for propagators, Floquet operators, Sambe systems, and time-dependent observables.

kpm-stochastic-adjoints.label: KPM and stochastic adjoints
kpm-stochastic-adjoints.description: Checkpointed reverse rules for Chebyshev recurrences, stochastic trace estimators, and common-random-number objectives.

topology-geometry-response.label: Topology, quantum geometry, and response composition
topology-geometry-response.description: Differentiable smooth proxies and tensor pipelines while keeping discrete invariants as independent forward validation.

boundary-localization.label: Boundary and localization composition
boundary-localization.description: Differentiable surface, finite-geometry, local-marker, localization, and finite-size-scaling observables.

transport-thermoelectric.label: Transport and thermoelectric composition
transport-thermoelectric.description: Adjoints for scattering and NEGF observables, including energy and bias derivatives, finite-temperature moments, and noise.

interaction-self-consistency.label: Interacting self-consistency
interaction-self-consistency.description: Forward and reverse support for mean-field maps, competing stationary solutions, thermodynamic potentials, and metastability.

multiscale-inference.label: Multiscale mapping and inference
multiscale-inference.description: Differentiable representation maps, constrained multi-observable losses, calibration, and independent forward validation.

nonsmooth-failure-semantics.label: Nonsmooth and discrete failure semantics
nonsmooth-failure-semantics.description: Typed handling of gap closings, branch changes, connectivity changes, solver switches, rank changes, and invalid gradients.

scale-error-diagnostics.label: Scale and error diagnostics
scale-error-diagnostics.description: Derivative error budgets, conditioning, convergence histories, memory accounting, checkpoint policies, and sparse-only guarantees.

identifiability-higher-order.label: Identifiability and higher-order products
identifiability-higher-order.description: Jacobian products, Fisher or Gauss-Newton operators, Hessian-vector products, nullspaces, and experiment-design diagnostics.

derivative-bindings.label: Derivative bindings
derivative-bindings.description: Stable Rust-native derivative entry points exposed consistently to Python and Julia without reimplementing scientific kernels.

heldout-generality.label: Held-out generality
heldout-generality.description: Evaluator-owned unseen models, hidden expected results, and anti-overfitting checks separate from public CI.
